title: Session 1: Introduction to Python
topicsOutline:
- What is Python? History and applications.
- Interactive Mode vs. Script Mode.
- Writing a simple "Hello, World!" script.

title: Session 2: Python IDEs & Numeric Types
topicsOutline:
- Overview of Python IDEs (VS Code, Jupyter).
- Numeric Data Types: int, float, complex.

title: Session 3: String Data Type
topicsOutline:
- String creation, indexing, and slicing.
- Common string methods (len(), upper(), lower(), title(), capitalize()).
- String concatenation and formatting.

title: Session 4: List Data Type
topicsOutline:
- List creation, indexing, and modification.
- List methods: append(), extend(), insert(), remove(), pop().
- Slicing and copying lists.

title: Session 5: Tuple & Set Data Types
topicsOutline:
- Tuples: Immutability, packing, and unpacking.
- Sets: Unordered collections, uniqueness.
- Set operations: union(), intersection(), difference().

title: Session 6: Dictionary Data Type
topicsOutline:
- Dictionaries: Key-value pairs.
- Creating, accessing, and modifying dictionary entries.
- Iterating over keys, values, and items.

title: Session 7: Variables & Operators (Part 1)
topicsOutline:
- Variable assignment and naming conventions.
- Arithmetic Operators (+, -, *, /, %, //, **).
- Relational/Comparison Operators (==, !=, >, <, >=, <=).

title: Session 8: Variables & Operators (Part 2)
topicsOutline:
- Logical Operators (and, or, not).
- Bitwise Operators

title: Session 9: Basic I/O Operations
topicsOutline:
- Reading user input using input().
- Displaying output using print().
- Formatted output with f-strings.

title: Session 10: Boolean Values & if Statements
topicsOutline:
- Boolean data type: True and False.
- Simple conditional execution with if.
- Indentation rules in Python.

title: Session 11: Advanced Conditional Execution
topicsOutline:
- Handling multiple conditions with if-elif-else.
- Writing programs with multiple branches of logic.

title: Session 12: Nested Conditions
topicsOutline:
- Nesting if statements for complex logic.
- Implementing multi-level decision-making.

title: Session 13: for Loops
topicsOutline:
- Iterating over sequences (lists, strings, tuples).
- Using the range() function for controlled iteration.

title: Session 14: while Loops
topicsOutline:
- Condition-based iteration with while.
- break and continue statements.

title: Session 15: Nested Loops & List Processing
topicsOutline:
- Using loops inside other loops (e.g., for pattern printing).
- Advanced list processing: sort(), reverse().

title: Session 16: Data Processing with Tuples & Dictionaries
topicsOutline:
- Iterating efficiently over dictionaries.
- Using tuple unpacking in loops.
- Practical data processing examples.

title: Session 17: String & Set Operations
topicsOutline:
- Advanced string methods.
- Practical applications of set operations (e.g., finding unique items).

title: Session 18: Logical & Bitwise Operations in Practice
topicsOutline:
- Short-circuiting in logical operations.
- Practical use cases for bitwise operations (e.g., flags).

title: Session 19: Introduction to Functions
topicsOutline:
- Defining functions with def.
- Parameters and arguments.
- The return statement.

title: Session 20: Function Arguments & Scope
topicsOutline:
- Local vs. Global variable scope.
- Default and keyword arguments.

title: Session 21: Multi-parameter Functions
topicsOutline:
- Variable-length positional arguments (*args).
- Variable-length keyword arguments (**kwargs).

title: Session 22: Anonymous Functions (Lambda)
topicsOutline:
- Syntax and use of lambda functions.
- Using lambdas with functions like sorted() and filter().

title: Session 23: Functional Tools (map, reduce)
topicsOutline:
- Applying a function to all items in an iterable with map().
- Cumulatively applying a function with functools.reduce().

title: Session 24: Functional Tools (filter, zip, enumerate)
topicsOutline:
- Filtering iterables with filter().
- Combining iterables with zip().
- Getting index and value with enumerate().

title: Session 25: Iterators
topicsOutline:
- The iterator protocol: iter() and next().
- Understanding how for loops work internally.

title: Session 26: Generators
topicsOutline:
- Creating generators with functions and the yield statement.
- Memory efficiency of generators vs. lists.

title: Session 27: List Comprehension
topicsOutline:
- Concise syntax for creating lists.
- Adding conditional logic to list comprehensions.
- Nested list comprehensions.

title: Session 28: Reading & Writing Text Files
topicsOutline:
- Opening files with open().
- Reading from files (read(), readline(), readlines()).
- Writing to files (write()).

title: Session 29: File Modes & with Statement
topicsOutline:
- File modes: 'r', 'w', 'a', 'r+', etc.
- Automatic file closing with the with statement.

title: Session 30: Working with Zip Files
topicsOutline:
- Introduction to the zipfile module.
- Compressing files into a zip archive.
- Decompressing/extracting files from a zip archive.

title: Session 31: Introduction to Exception Handling
topicsOutline:
- Handling runtime errors with try...except blocks.
- Catching specific exceptions (ValueError, FileNotFoundError).

title: Session 32: Advanced Exception Handling
topicsOutline:
- Using the else block for code that runs when no exception occurs.
- Using the finally block for cleanup code.

title: Session 33: Raising & User-Defined Exceptions
topicsOutline:
- Raising exceptions with the raise keyword.
- Creating custom exception classes.

title: Session 34: Introduction to Modules
topicsOutline:
- Organizing code into .py files (modules).
- Importing modules: import and from...import.

title: Session 35: Introduction to Packages
topicsOutline:
- Organizing modules into directories (packages).
- The role of the __init__.py file.

title: Session 36: Standard Library Modules
topicsOutline:
- Exploring useful modules in the standard library.
- Examples: math, random, sys.

title: Session 37: os Module (File & Directory Ops)
topicsOutline:
- Interacting with the operating system.
- File system operations: os.listdir(), os.mkdir(), os.rename().

title: Session 38: os Module (Environment Variables)
topicsOutline:
- Accessing system environment variables.
- os.environ and os.getenv().

title: Session 39: datetime Module (Manipulation)
topicsOutline:
- Working with dates and times (date, time, datetime).
- Time differences with timedelta.

title: Session 40: datetime Module (Formatting)
topicsOutline:
- Formatting datetime objects into strings (strftime()).
- Parsing strings into datetime objects (strptime()).

title: Session 41: json Module (Parsing)
topicsOutline:
- Introduction to JSON format.
- Converting between Python objects and JSON (dumps(), loads()).

title: Session 42: json Module (Nested Structures)
topicsOutline:
- Working with complex, nested JSON data.
- Reading from and writing to .json files (dump(), load()).

title: Session 43: Introduction to NumPy
topicsOutline:
- NumPy ndarray objects.
- Array creation and basic operations.
- Introduction to linear algebra with NumPy.

title: Session 44: Introduction to Pandas (Part 1)
topicsOutline:
- Core Pandas data structures: Series and DataFrame.
- Creating DataFrames from dictionaries or lists.

title: Session 45: Introduction to Pandas (Part 2)
topicsOutline:
- Reading data from CSV files with pd.read_csv().
- Writing DataFrames to CSV files with df.to_csv().
- Course wrap-up and review.
